name: Eng. Dr. Lusungu Ndovi, FEIZ
role: Group Lead Consultant, Technical, Engineering and EPC Projects
bio: Leads engineering analysis, system design and EPC project execution across solar, energy infrastructure and emerging technologies, upholding the highest standards of quality and safety.
messageTitle: Engineering solutions that are practical, innovative and sustainable.
message: Our strength lies in our ability to assess complex engineering challenges, conduct detailed technical analyses, design fit-for-purpose solutions and successfully implement projects that create lasting value for our clients.

Whether in solar energy systems, energy infrastructure, project management, financial modelling or green-technology innovation, we remain committed to the highest standards of professionalism, quality and safety.
